start_here: Say to your AI: "List my TidyCal booking types." It runs tool:list-my-tidycal-booking-types with no input.
no_lists_because: It keeps no list of yours: it reads your TidyCal account and writes nothing.
instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "List my TidyCal booking types". It calls tools:run with tool tool:list-my-tidycal-booking-types and an empty input.
2. Read each booking type's id, title, duration and public booking address.
3. Use a booking address as the link a booker opens to book that type.

worked_examples.title: List the booking types on my TidyCal account
worked_examples.given: Reads tools/tidycal/what-this-tool-does-and-how-to-run-it.json: a GET to https://tidycal.com/api/booking-types with the vault key tidycal-api-token as a bearer header. Reads only.
worked_examples.hands_back: It answers the booking types, for example "Private call, 30 minutes, booking address tidycal.com/<your-slug>/private-call" with its numeric id.
